meaning: Variance: signal power around the mean.
Root mean square: overall amplitude including offset.
Sum of squares: total signal energy of the segment.
Peak-to-peak: max minus min, sensitive to large spikes.
Skewness: asymmetry of the amplitude distribution.
Excess kurtosis: heavy tails / spikiness of the amplitude distribution.
Sum of |x[n+1]-x[n]|: grows with amplitude and with fast oscillation; classic seizure feature.
Hjorth mobility: sqrt(var(dx)/var(x)); proxy for the mean frequency.
Hjorth complexity: how much the waveform deviates from a pure sine.
Absolute band power (area under the Welch PSD inside the band). (frequency unit: cycles/sample)
Relative band power: band power / total power over the bands. (frequency unit: cycles/sample)
Frequency of the largest PSD peak (excluding 0). (frequency unit: cycles/sample)
Power-weighted mean frequency of the PSD. (frequency unit: cycles/sample)
Normalised Shannon entropy of the PSD (0 = single tone, 1 = flat/white). (frequency unit: cycles/sample)
Frequency below which 95% of the power lies. (frequency unit: cycles/sample)
